description:
Podpin is the podcast player built for listeners who want more than play and pause.

Listen to your favorite podcasts, follow episodes with AI-powered transcripts, save important moments with highlights and bookmarks, and turn long conversations into something searchable and useful.

With Podpin you can:
- Listen in a fast, focused podcast player
- Read transcripts while you listen
- Highlight key moments and save bookmarks
- Browse episodes with chapter-style structure and insights
- Find books, movies, links, and references mentioned in episodes
- Revisit what matters without losing your place

Podpin is made for curious listeners, students, researchers, and anyone who wants to turn podcasts into usable knowledge.

Download Podpin and make podcasts easier to read, search, and remember.\n\nTerms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
promotionalText: Listen, read transcripts, save bookmarks, and get back to the moments that matter in every podcast.
whatsNew: Discover podcasts on the road with new CarPlay browsing and Siri support. Browse trending shows and categories, then confirm before following—nothing follows or plays automatically. Ask Siri to find a show or resume what is currently playing. Episode playback, sharing, mini-player reliability, and transcript-based pins are also improved.
